name: Quality HVAC by Fibid
verdict: Google Ads drove all $1,043.35 in spend over 28 days and recorded 11 conversions, but the lead_drought flag is critical since zero leads are being captured in the CRM, suggesting a tracking disconnect between Google Ads conversions and actual form/call leads. GBP engagement dropped 34.21% week-over-week, the sharpest channel decline, though it still generated 25 calls and 57 direction requests, signaling organic demand that paid efforts should better support.

performance.verdict: Spend is live but leads are phantom — CRM blind, scale gate still blocked.

findings.text: lead_drought confirmed: 0 CRM leads across all 28 days despite $1,043.35 Google spend and 11 reported Google Ads conversions — tracking disconnect, not a demand failure.
Booking bot battle-test (due 2026-07-31) and Review Boost campaign (due 2026-08-31) both overdue — GHL automation cannot be trusted or scaled without these verified.
Intake owner unconfirmed since Vivian left 7/7 (due 2026-08-31); Financing page and Homer Glen branch page also overdue 2026-08-31 — 4 milestones missed, scale-up gate remains hard-blocked.

3-day spend signal (Aug 29–31: $2.73, $28.67, $86.87) vs prior 3 (Aug 26–28: $10.57, $19.61, $11.08) shows spend spiking back up while GBP actions hit 0 for 3 consecutive days (Aug 29–31) — organic demand erosion concurrent with paid uptick.
GHL shows 55 opportunities created and 24 won against 0 CRM leads and 0 appointments — pipeline numbers are orphaned from ad attribution; intake leak, not an ads problem.

suggestions.text: Audit Google Ads conversion action and GHL form/call tracking to resolve 0-lead CRM read against 11 reported conversions.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads reports 11 conversions against $1,043.35 spend over 28 days, but CRM shows 0 leads and 0 appointments — the conversion action is not writing to GHL. Audit the Google Ads conversion tag (call extension vs form), confirm GHL webhook or Zapier connector is live and receiving, and cross-reference the 55 GHL opportunities against any offline source. Success = at least one confirmed lead path writing to GHL within 7 days. Re-check by 2026-09-08.

suggestions.text: Confirm intake owner, GHL login, and after-hours coverage — hard gate blocking any budget increase per SOW.
suggestions.monday_update: Vivian (dispatch) left 2026-07-07 and intake ownership is unconfirmed as of 2026-09-01, which is the stated blocker on raising budgets per the SOW scale-back-up gate. Identify the new owner, confirm their GHL login is active, and verify after-hours coverage handoff. Success = named owner with verified GHL access confirmed in writing to Sohib. Deadline: 2026-09-08 to unblock any spend decisions.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP actions: 0 for 3 consecutive days (Aug 29–31) — re-check at next window before drawing conclusions.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions hit 0 for three straight days (Aug 29–31) after averaging 4–6 actions/day earlier in August, and the 7-day GBP delta is already -34.21%. This may be a Windsor data lag (flagged in SOW for last 2–3 days of any GBP window) or genuine organic demand erosion. Do not act yet. Re-check on 2026-09-04 with a full 3-day confirmed read before escalating.
